description: Land the current guardrail and first data-flow correction. Add the test-only TransportPlan validator that runs after plan commit and rejects any position, seam, callable resolution, boundary, lane, callable, or shape reference outside the committed reachable graph. Fix call-boundary argument demand upstream so callable-typed arguments to opaque closure calls become first-class runtime obligations before transport. Make transport callable resolutions canonical by passing through world.activation_key(...) and requiring the resulting ExecutableKey to exist in the settled semantic contexts. Worked examples: opaque callable argument fn main(f) { g = fn(x)->x+1; f.(g) } and Enumerable.reduce suspend continuation. Checks: cargo test runtime_demand -- --nocapture; cargo test transport_ -- --nocapture; cargo fmt --check; git diff --check.
title: Transport authority: validate root-scoped callable executable facts
